textNodes.text: Variable fonts have a weight axis that most sites set once and never touch. I wanted to know what happens when the reader holds the axis in their hand.
textNodes.fontFamily: "Mona Sans Variable", "Mona Sans Variable Placeholder", sans-serif

textNodes.text: One weekend, one screen, one rule: drag anywhere and the letters get heavier the further you pull.
textNodes.fontFamily: "Mona Sans Variable", "Mona Sans Variable Placeholder", sans-serif
"Mona Sans Variable", "Mona Sans Variable Placeholder", sans-serif

textNodes.text: A small React component with one animation loop. Pointer distance goes in, an eased weight value comes out, and the text reads it through a CSS variable.
textNodes.fontFamily: "Mona Sans Variable", "Mona Sans Variable Placeholder", sans-serif

textNodes.text: One requestAnimationFrame loop for everything that moves
